segments.ch08.s0010: A large rose-tree stood near the entrance of the garden.
segments.ch08.s0020: The roses growing on it were white.
segments.ch08.s0030: But there were three gardeners at it, busily painting them red.
segments.ch08.s0050: Do not go splashing paint over me like that!
segments.ch08.s0060: Would you tell me why you are painting those roses?
segments.ch08.s0070: Why, the fact is, you see, Miss, this here ought to have been a red rose-tree.
segments.ch08.s0080: We put a white one in by mistake.
segments.ch08.s0090: If the Queen was to find it out, we should all have our heads cut off, you know.
segments.ch08.s0120: The three gardeners instantly threw themselves flat upon their faces.
segments.ch08.s0130: There was a sound of many footsteps.
segments.ch08.s0140: First came ten soldiers carrying clubs.
segments.ch08.s0150: They were oblong and flat, with their hands and feet at the corners.
segments.ch08.s0160: Next the ten courtiers, ornamented all over with diamonds.
segments.ch08.s0170: After these came the royal children, jumping merrily along hand in hand.
segments.ch08.s0180: Then the guests, and among them Alice recognised the White Rabbit.
segments.ch08.s0190: Then the Knave of Hearts, carrying the King's crown on a crimson velvet cushion.
segments.ch08.s0200: And last of all this grand procession came the King and Queen of Hearts.
segments.ch08.s0230: My name is Alice, so please your Majesty.
segments.ch08.s0240: Why, they are only a pack of cards, after all.
segments.ch08.s0250: I need not be afraid of them!
segments.ch08.s0280: It is no business of mine.
segments.ch08.s0290: The Queen turned crimson with fury.
segments.ch08.s0330: Consider, my dear: she is only a child!
segments.ch08.s0350: The three gardeners ran to Alice for protection.
segments.ch08.s0370: And she put them into a large flower-pot that stood near.
segments.ch08.s0420: People began running about in all directions, tumbling up against each other.
segments.ch08.s0430: Alice had never seen such a curious croquet-ground in her life.
segments.ch08.s0440: It was all ridges and furrows.
segments.ch08.s0450: The balls were live hedgehogs, and the mallets live flamingoes.
segments.ch08.s0460: The soldiers had to double themselves up and stand on their hands and feet.
segments.ch08.s0480: The chief difficulty Alice found at first was in managing her flamingo.
segments.ch08.s0490: Just as she was going to give the hedgehog a blow with its head, it would twist round.
segments.ch08.s0500: It looked up in her face with such a puzzled expression that she burst out laughing.
segments.ch08.s0510: And when she had got its head down, the hedgehog had unrolled itself and crawled away.
segments.ch08.s0520: The doubled-up soldiers were always getting up and walking off to other parts.
segments.ch08.s0530: Alice soon came to the conclusion that it was a very difficult game indeed.
segments.ch08.s0540: The players all played at once without waiting for turns, quarrelling all the while.
segments.ch08.s0550: In a very short time the Queen was in a furious passion.
segments.ch08.s0580: She shouted it about once in a minute.
segments.ch08.s0590: Then she noticed a curious appearance in the air.
segments.ch08.s0600: After watching it a minute or two, she made it out to be a grin.
segments.ch08.s0610: It is the Cheshire Cat: now I shall have somebody to talk to.
segments.ch08.s0630: Alice waited till the eyes appeared, and then nodded.
segments.ch08.s0640: In another minute the whole head appeared, and no more of it.
segments.ch08.s0650: I do not think they play at all fairly.
segments.ch08.s0660: And you have no idea how confusing it is, all the things being alive.
segments.ch08.s0670: How do you like the Queen?
segments.ch08.s0700: It is a friend of mine, a Cheshire Cat.
segments.ch08.s0710: I do not like the look of it at all.
segments.ch08.s0720: A cat may look at a king.
segments.ch08.s0750: You cannot cut off a head unless there is a body to cut it off from.
segments.ch08.s0760: Anything that has a head can be beheaded.
segments.ch08.s0770: It belongs to the Duchess: you had better ask her about it.
segments.ch08.s0780: The Cat's head began fading away the moment the executioner was gone.
segments.ch08.s0790: By the time he had come back with the Duchess, it had entirely disappeared.
segments.ch08.s0800: So the King and the executioner ran wildly up and down looking for it.
segments.ch08.s0810: And the rest of the party went back to the game.
